kept_items.text: Yesterday $IREN completed its acquisition of Nostrum Group, marking its expansion into Europe with approximately 490MW of secured, grid-connected power capacity in Spain. The deal strengthens IREN's AI cloud infrastructure platform.

kept_items.text: Anthropic's new Mythos model has sparked significant concern regarding its fearsome AI power and the potential risks it poses to global security. John Reed explains what you need to know about the cutting-edge AI tool.

kept_items.author: dharmesh
kept_items.text: Do not infer with AI that which can be queried without. That's from an internal presentation I gave at HubSpot today. LLMs are great, but there are a lot of use cases that are much better handled with a structured query (like SQL).
kept_items.selection_reason: Named practitioner (HubSpot CTO) concrete engineering principle; useful analysis.
